name: 流式审核抽检 — 抽检复核同意原结论
description: 验证抽检人对流式拦截任务执行复核，判定'正确'（同意原审核结论），任务放行流出下游。

steps.expression: (() => { const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a, [cursor=pointer], button, span')).filter(e => e.textContent.includes('查看详情') || e.textContent.includes('查看')); const firstLink = links[0]; if (firstLink) { firstLink.click(); return { clicked: true, text: firstLink.textContent.trim() }; } return { clicked: false, note: '未找到查看详情按钮' }; })()
steps.description: 点击第一条抽检任务查看详情

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button], span')).map(b => b.textContent.trim()).filter(t => t.length > 0 && t.length < 20); const hasCorrect = text.includes('正确') || text.includes('同意') || text.includes('通过'); const hasIncorrect = text.includes('不正确') || text.includes('不同意') || text.includes('驳回'); return { pageText: text.substring(0, 500), buttons: buttons.slice(0, 30), hasCorrect, hasIncorrect }; })()
steps.description: 验证抽检详情页包含正确/不正确判定选项

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在待抽检的流式拦截任务
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.打开个人任务中心 2.切换抽检任务Tab 3.点击查看详情 4.验证抽检详情页包含正确/不正确判定
_testDesign.expectedResult: 抽检详情页可见原审核结论，抽检人可判定'正确'或'不正确'
_testDesign.apiAssertion: 抽检提交API /api/afd/review/inspection/audit/submit 返回成功
riskPoints: 前端选项文案可能是'正确/不正确'而非'同意/不同意'
_testDesign.prdMapping: 抽检执行与改判处理 - 复核判定
